feat(camellia): migrate universal content operation pages

Summary:
- add camellia content-operation routes for feedback, agreement,
  tutorial, issue, explanation, and notification
- wire the sidebar, hidden feedback detail route, and a minimal token
  login flow that matches the legacy woodii bearer-token model
- add shared camellia request, session, and query-field helpers so the
  migrated pages reuse consistent table, form, and dialog patterns

Rationale:
- DAM-22 requires the first migration slice of woodii universal content
  pages to run from the new camellia stack instead of the legacy Vue app
- keeping auth/session and x-app request wiring shared avoids six route
  modules each re-implementing the same legacy integration details
- the first pass preserves core CRUD and handling flows while tolerating
  missing local auth context during build-time validation

Tests:
- pnpm install
- pnpm run check:camellia
- PORT=3210 pnpm --filter @bougainvillea/camellia start
- curl route smoke for /, /content/feedback, /content/agreement,
  /content/tutorial, /content/issue, /content/explanation,
  /content/notification, /content/feedback/test-id
